Note: The census covered agricultural holdings that met at least one of the following thresholds: 0.1 ha of land; one cattle of three years of age or more; two cattle of any age; five pigs, sheep or goats; or two horses, mules or asses. Holdings not including any agricultural land but devoted solely to the forestry production or solely to the breeding of poultry, rabbits and bees, were not covered by the census.
The census covered agricultural production unit (UPA) with at least 500 m2. Those less than 500 m2 were considered UPAs only if they produced one or more products for sale during the census year.
